findings.highlight: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.
findings.evidenceJa: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
findings.governingReading: Body is beyond saving, but stopping now might preserve meaningful selfhood for about a day; the next line calls this one-day life extension.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverable body and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and a worthwhile current day.

findings.highlight: Not outside, but inside my forebrain.
findings.evidenceJa: 外ではなく内、大脳の側座核が割れた。
findings.governingReading: An internal crack is located specifically in 大脳の側座核, with motivation/pleasure gloss following.
findings.explanation: Specified nucleus accumbens becomes generic forebrain.

findings.highlight: I can't stop the agony of loss and the disappearance of my memories.
findings.evidenceJa: 失み欠う苦痛も、記憶の消失を止められない。
findings.governingReading: Even the pain of loss cannot halt disappearing memories.
findings.explanation: Pain cannot stop memory loss becomes he cannot stop both pain and memory loss.
